title: You Are Still Becoming
devotional: You may look at your life and see how much still needs to change. That can be discouraging if you expect yourself to become completely different overnight. But spiritual growth is a process. God is still working in you. The goal of this journey was never to make you believe that you will never struggle again. It was to help you become more aware, more prepared, more disciplined, and more willing to turn toward God. Keep growing. Keep learning. Keep getting back up. Your story is not finished.
mind_check: What area of your life still needs growth, and how can you approach it with patience instead of discouragement?
body_move: Do one physical activity today that reminds you that growth comes through consistent practice rather than instant results.
spirit_move: Thank God for the work He has already begun in you. Ask Him for patience and perseverance as He continues shaping your character.
way_out: When I become discouraged by how far I still have to go, I will remember __________ and take __________ next step.
prayer: Father, thank You that my story is still being written. Help me not to become discouraged by the areas where I still need to grow. Give me patience with the process and courage to keep moving forward. Continue shaping my mind, body, character, and faith so that my life reflects You more each day. Amen.
action: Write a short letter to your future self. Describe the person you want to become over the next year and name three habits you will practice to move in that direction.
